newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Empty bottles pay the way for Russian cinema goers.
newsitem.headline: Empty bottles pay the way for Russian cinema goers.

text.p: Cinema managers in Siberia, who started accepting eggs as payment for tickets last summer because local people had no cash to spare, are now charging customers in empty bottles because of an egg shortage.

Itar-Tass news agency said on Saturday a cinema in Russia's Altai region had started charging local people, most of whom live off the land, two eggs per ticket to attract customers. The idea caught on in other parts of Altai.
But the cinemas hit a problem in winter because hens lay fewer eggs in sub-zero temperatures and audiences started dwindling.

The enterprising cinema workers then came up with the idea of accepting empty bottles as payment -- a currency in big supply at this festive season and all year. They then return the bottles to manufacturers in exchange for money.
